content:
BUILT CoLAB celebrated its third anniversary on September 16. To mark the date, it brought together all the employees from the Porto and Lisbon offices for a picnic in Porto’s city park, promoting conviviality among everyone.

This third year of activity was marked by the conclusion of structuring projects for the AEC sector – REV@CONSTRUCTION, FoC – Future of Construction, and PACCO – Action Plan for Circularity in Construction – as well as the start of others and the renewal of basic funding as a Collaborative Laboratory, through the “Interface Mission”.

We thus continue our mission to promote the Twin Transition in the AEC sector, increasing its competitiveness and potential to respond to current challenges in the field of Digitalization and Sustainability, with a dynamic team and the support of all our associates.
